name: workflow-state-paths
title: The source of truth names two artifacts that are not there
description: Measured: .trellis/workflow.md, which every agent reads first and which calls itself the workflow source of truth, names .trellis/scripts/inject-workflow-state.py and a spec under spec/cli/backend/ - and the script actually ships at .claude/hooks and .codex/hooks. It is tracked tool content with no managed block, so the correction has to live on our side of the boundary
